## jp.square-enix.com game page (Platform; Nintendo 3DS and Wii U; Japanese)

- https://www.jp.square-enix.com/game/detail/p_ffne/ -- the 3DS and Wii U rows -- accessed 2026-10-24 (page text pasted by user)

## an.sqexm.net (Platform; Square Enix Mobile, Android)

- http://an.sqexm.net/sp/site/Page/sqmk/pictlogica/top -- the Android row -- accessed 2026-10-20 (Wayback capture of 2013-10-26, found by the user: https://web.archive.org/web/20131026131743/http://an.sqexm.net/sp/site/Page/sqmk/pictlogica/top)
  - PICTLOGICA FINAL FANTASY on the Square Enix Mobile Android site: free to play with item purchases, about 40 MB plus about 70 MB of extra data, a puzzle RPG, Android 2.3 or later recommended, purchases cannot be cancelled; "a new puzzle RPG where you solve picture puzzles from the Final Fantasy series' pixel art and fight battles"; (C) SQUARE ENIX, developed by Jupiter
